findings.evidence: The response labels three SMS alternatives and tells the operator to choose one, rather than producing the requested three proposed touches.
findings.impact: The operator receives variants for a single send, without the requested follow-up timing, per-touch purpose or full sequence stop/branch structure.
findings.repair: Make the output contract three ordered touches with purpose, relative timing, message and stop/branch conditions. Generate alternatives only when explicitly requested.
findings.retest: Repeat the normal case on both hosts and the frozen regressions on the matching repaired source. Retain the existing approval, date, consent and opt-out guards, and preserve all prior attempts.
